brief: The canvas presents a vivid, cross-section view of a tide pool, dominated by rich natural colors and intricate life. Within this ecosystem, brightly colored anemones are anchored to the substrate. When these anemones are fully open, they trigger a dynamic change in the water: the surface begins to ripple outwards from their center. These newly formed ripples interact with the surrounding background water, which concurrently exhibits subtle, swirling currents that flow continually, drawing attention to the outward movement across the scene.
